data_sources.soil: SoilGrids v2.0 — ISRIC REST API (shallowest depth ~0-5cm)
data_sources.dem: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 100m EPSG:32637 — Planetary Computer
data_sources.modis_lpi: MODIS MOD13Q1 v061 250m EPSG:32637 — Planetary Computer
data_sources.chirps: CHIRPS v2.0 2014–2023 annual TIFs — CHC UCSB /vsicurl/

community_intelligence.community_preferred_future: Restore coffee-forest agroforestry with market access; halt further encroachment
community_intelligence.local_degradation_memory: Elders report >40% forest loss since 1980; stream flow declining; springs failing in dry season
community_intelligence.grazing_rules: Traditional Aari/Kafa customary law governs forest use but enforcement is weakening
community_intelligence.labor_constraints: Coffee harvest (Sep-Dec) absorbs all available labor; restoration outside this window only
community_intelligence.gendered_burdens: Women spend 2-4h/day on fuelwood and water collection; restoration must reduce these burdens
community_intelligence.youth_opportunities: Coffee nursery enterprise, ecotourism guiding, FMNR training, drone monitoring technicians
community_intelligence.local_conflict_risks: Boundary conflicts at forest margins between highland farmers and lowland pastoralists
community_intelligence.tenure_constraints: Forest tenure ambiguous between federal authority, regional government, and customary users
adoption_barriers: Lack of seedling nurseries at scale
local_success_indicators: Bird species return to restored areas
